description:
Russell Brand sits down with Alex Jones as Alex breaks down exactly where the great awakening stands right now and why the globalists are in full panic mode. Alex argues that because they know they have lost the information war all they can do is target whoever is prominent, whoever is telling the truth and whoever cannot be bought. Tucker Carlson, Candace Owens, Russell, Alex himself. All targets for the same reason. Alex then reveals that fighting tyranny is not a duty for him but a full blown addiction, that the Holy Spirit produces a high so powerful that you could put a gun to his head and he still could not sell out. Russell follows with his own visceral account of coming to Christ not as a choice or a decision but as something that grabbed him by the throat in the brokenness of personal crisis and never let go.
